title: Al-'Alaq 96:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Qadr, Al-'Alaq 1 to 12 and the noon sakinah rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-'Alaq 96:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 14. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ (٥) كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ (٦) أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ (٧) إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Taught man that which he knew not.
Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-'Alaq 96:5-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 96:5-8 together without the mushaf.
people becoming proud and going too far
options: people becoming proud and going too far

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 96:5-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write one thing Allah has taught you and one way you can thank Him.
questions.a: For example: Allah taught me to read; I thank Him by reading the Qur'an every day.

questions.q: Link 96:1 to 8 and recite it to a partner. Which ayah was hardest to link?
questions.a: Recited in order; pupil names the hardest link (often 96:5 to 6).

questions.q: 96:8 says that to your Lord is ...
questions.a: A) the return. 'Indeed, to your Lord is the return' (96:8). Everyone returns to Allah.

questions.q: Think again: Allah taught people what they did not know. What is something you know now that you did not know last year?
questions.a: All knowledge is from Allah (96:5); we thank Him and use it well, not with pride (96:6 to 7).
